# Narration Timeline

## Shot 1 — Question 1

**Duration:** 7.5s

Could player two steer the ducks in Duck Hunt? True. A second controller moved the duck around the screen!

## Shot 2 — Question 2

**Duration:** 7.5s

Do classic arcade light guns shoot real laser beams? False. The gun sensor detects flashing light on the screen!

## Shot 3 — Question 3

**Duration:** 7.5s

Was Pac-Man inspired by a pizza missing one slice? True. The creator got the idea while eating round pizza!
